info.name: FLOW - DataSource CRUD (Generic)
info.description:
**Generic E2E DataSource flow — zero hardcoded values.**

All DB config comes from `--env-var` flags or environment file.
Table names and queries are captured dynamically from the metadata graph.
Stop-on-fail: any failed step skips remaining steps (teardown always runs).

**Steps:**
00 Setup → 01 Test Connection → 02 Create → 03 Get → 04 Test by ID → 05 Fetch Graph → 06 Sample → 07 Query → 08 Update → 09 Verify → 10 Delete → 11 Verify Deleted → 99 Teardown

**Required --env-var:**
```
test_username, test_password, client_secret
driverType, dbHost, dbPort, dbName, dbUser, dbPassword, dbSchema
driverClassName, aesRandomIV
```

**Driver reference:**
| DB | driverType | driverClassName | Port |
|---|---|---|---|
| MySQL | MYSQL | com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver | 3306 |
| MariaDB | MARIADB | org.mariadb.jdbc.Driver | 3306 |
| PostgreSQL | POSTGRES | org.postgresql.Driver | 5432 |
| Oracle | ORACLE | oracle.jdbc.OracleDriver | 1521 |
| SQL Server | MSSQL | com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.SQLServerDriver | 1433 |

**Example:**
```bash
newman run flows/FLOW-DataSource-CRUD.postman_collection.json \
  -e environments/onprem-api.postman_environment.json --insecure \
  --env-var test_username=onpremquipu \
  --env-var test_password=onpremquipu \
  --env-var client_secret=SECRET \
  --env-var driverType=POSTGRES \
  --env-var dbHost=207.180.249.216 \
  --env-var dbPort=5433 \
  --env-var dbName=healthcare_management \
  --env-var dbUser=postgres \
  --env-var dbPassword=ENCRYPTED \
  --env-var dbSchema=public \
  --env-var driverClassName=org.postgresql.Driver \
  --env-var aesRandomIV=IV_BASE64 \
  -r cli
```
